verdict.rationale: Polar documents an embedded checkout that keeps buyers on the merchant's own site without redirecting (polar-docs-9), including an embedded payment-method view (polar-supp-checkout-links). It also offers a Checkout Session API with client-side get/update/confirm endpoints for deeper, API-driven integration into a site or app (polar-docs-8). missing for 10: documented customization/theming controls for the embedded components, granular component-level elements beyond a drop-in checkout, independent or hands-on corroboration.
